hack.root_cause: Cross-chain Message Forgery — Privileged Contract Caller Manipulation
hack.description: Poly Network lost $611M — the largest crypto hack ever at the time — when an attacker exploited a cross-chain message routing flaw to replace the bridge's keeper keys with their own, then returned every dollar days later claiming it was done "for fun."
